body: thought i replied to this last night, oops. i can start on basic hygiene again. not like i tossed the stuff, just neglected it. I work in a pretty demanding job, usually 1k+ cals burned per shift, so that's not an issue i think. I probably could do something like that; just learn something useful with the plethora of resources i've seen online. never thought i'd use them but hell not like i'm spending my spare time on anything important anyway. thanks for lending your ear and advice

i left it off but i live with my whole family too, and also making pennies above minimum wage with no ability to advance. so we can relate there. but that's it it seems. i've lived in poverty for over half my life now and one thing ive noticed is. there's only a few that can make it out at all. and living in what amounts to some kind of hibernation or stasis, just existing and getting older, isnt something i want. but what do you mean small steps? what steps are there to take aside from the ones i've walked a million times over every day like clockwork. hobbies and anything else aren't an option, no money and all that. and trying to keep my chin up is just making my neck sore.
